Fed & Policy Watch
  • The prior day's FOMC meeting and press conference are elapsed at the 00:30 ET cutoff; no statement outcome is asserted here. Today's GDP advance estimate and September Personal Income and Outlays/PCE are both independently listed by BEA and New York Fed for 8:30 AM; checked dates/times agree.
  • Today's 7-year note competitive auction closes at 1:00 PM; 4- and 8-week bill bids close at 11:30 AM. Weekly H.4.1 is scheduled today at 4:30 PM and again Thu Nov 5 at 4:30 PM. H.8 is listed Fri Oct 30 and Fri Nov 6 at 4:15 PM; Board calendar checked against each release's own day list.
  • Chicago Fed schedules NFCI publication for Fri Oct 30 at 8:30 AM for the week ending Oct 23. The Oct 23 CSV observation is -0.487; it is a weekly measure, not a live liquidity reading.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: BEA and New York Fed agree on Oct 29 at 8:30 AM for GDP (3rd Quarter 2026) and Personal Income and Outlays (September 2026); no conflict found for checked overlapping entries. The Oct/Nov New York Fed calendars, BEA, Census, Chicago Fed, TreasuryDirect, Fed Board, EIA, NAR and Treasury sources were checked. BLS.gov was not requested; BLS release dates/times use the New York Fed calendar.
  • Chicago Fed lists a CFNAI October 2026 advance release date of Oct 29 but no ET time on the checked calendar; omitted from timed rows rather than assigning a time. Chicago Fed NFCI is dated Oct 30, not today. EIA schedules provide holiday-adjusted petroleum dates (Nov 12) and natural-gas date (Nov 13); no date-specific Oct 29/Nov 5 energy release was verified. No unverified recurring weekday date was inferred.
  • TreasuryDirect upcoming-auction records for future Nov 2-6 did not provide complete verified competitive close times in the returned records; no timed auction rows are inferred. New York Fed calendar dates/times are tentative and subject to change. Selected calendar only; checked sources are not exhaustive.
  • WTI is $101.47, down 1.27% from Wednesday's completed generic futures bar; monitor energy sensitivity without assigning a catalyst. No verified unscheduled geopolitical or policy watch item from this run; this is not a full risk review. No exchange-specific market-structure item or product-hours review was verified.
  • Yahoo is a single-source vendor quote for the market snapshot; futures are generic continuous-series quotes, not official settlements. Classifier self-test passed; unmatched events remain provisional Medium, not silently Low. Reconfirm live prices, event/auction updates, market depth and selected contract before execution.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
SPY's Wednesday vendor close rose 0.34%, while ES=F is 0.42% below Wednesday's completed daily bar in the early Thursday quote. The official 10Y close rose 6 bp to 5.05%; MOVE at 94.55 remains in the moderate-uncertainty band and VIX is 16.91. GDP and PCE arrive together at 8:30 AM, followed by a 7-year note auction at 1:00 PM. Treat gap and post-data price discovery as event-sensitive; wait for live yields, volatility and liquidity confirmation. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES extends a move without confirmation from Treasury yields, volatility or market depth; if GDP/PCE or auction repricing overturns the initial response; or if the selected contract's hours/liquidity differ. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Verify the contract, event updates and fresh quotes before execution.
